subject: general
question: Preeti, Umang, Shrina, Palak and Amrita are sitting in a straight line, all facing the north. Palak is sitting at the left corner. Umang is third to the right of Shrina. Preeti is to the immediate left of Amrita. Who is sitting to the immediate left of Umang?
solution:
**Five person: **Preeti, Umang, Shrina, Palak and Amrita

1) Palak is sitting at the left corner.

2) Umag is third to the right of Shrina.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb8aefb5d0e988c2d2aaba239b29c1a3db8b894188b29b96546318c7e7a7af3e.png] 

3) Preeti is to the immediate left of Amrita.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df2c0cd5c02f36a0cdc5f9e9ef136cb69ca02bedfac2936536c36ef69dee3bc0.png] 

Clearly, Amrita is sitting immediate left of Umang.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Amrita".**
